name: ecommerce-promotions-filament
description: The merchant-facing Filament panel over the promotions domain: offer authoring, the append-only status decision log and revision archive, the redemption ledger with its releases, and a basket evaluation that names why an offer was skipped.
features: Offer authoring that expresses every term the domain accepts and refuses every term it rejects
Status decided through the domain's decision action, never by editing a column
The append-only status decision log, showing who changed an offer and when
The append-only revision archive, showing what an offer's terms were at each revision
Codes issued per offer, never searchable and never filterable
The redemption ledger with its releases, and releasing a use back with a closed-enum reason
Basket evaluation that names every skipped offer with its refusal reason
A ledger integrity widget that recomputes the cached counter and status from the append-only tables
Every unpublished ability forced false by name, per resource and per relation manager
